Third Party · Overview

Angular apps often mix the framework with third-party UI and tooling. This section covers four you will see in interviews and real teams: Bootstrap, Tailwind, Storybook, and Ag-Grid (Community).

How this lab approaches them

  • Bootstrap / Tailwind — teach install + wiring without taking over this app’s global CSS (Material already themes the shell).
  • Storybook — live workshop in this lab (stories, Controls, Actions, Docs, tutorial + context help). Real Storybook is still npx storybook@latest init.
  • Ag-Grid Community — live demo installed here so you can click a real grid (sort, filter, resize).
